description: MPA WP5a's later-filing evidence on the analysis dataset (docs/mpa-improvements/coherence.md section 1.6 items 2-5), planted in the wire shape the page reads (frontend/features/analysis/api/analysis-api.ts FirstReported, yoy_first_reported); the producer (WP5a-B, backend/app/services/trend_analysis/first_reports.py) builds that shape from stored own-report rows, and the datasets it builds are pinned apart, in analysis_first_reports_produced.json. Values are REGN's as WP5b's test stores them (backend/tests/unit/test_companyfacts_own_report_history.py), plus a planted sign flip and scale factor. Every case is an annual run: only an annual run carries evidence (D5), and the page refuses it in a quarterly one. Each case's expected holds the later-filing places: values, the figures that carry their own first_reported (reported figures only: the page refuses it on a calculated figure, whose evidence sits on its inputs), and comparisons, the YoY changes whose yoy_first_reported is present; both over the dataset's periods only, in series order, then period order; a comparison counts by the key's presence, null included, and an explicit first_reported null is no evidence. Across a sign or scale finding on either year, on the figure or on any input of its calculation, yoy_first_reported is 'nm', never a number or null. frontend/tests/unit/later-filings.spec.tsx runs the page's laterFilingPlaces (features/analysis/lib/laterFilings.ts) over every case and renders the pages on them; the backend's twin of laterFilingPlaces (WP5a-X, the exports) reads the same cases.

cases.name: regn_own_reports_beside_later_comparatives
cases.about: WP5b's REGN shape at D1's 0.1%: revenue FY2018 and FY2019 and total assets FY2018 carry their own 10-K's value. Revenue's and net margin's changes FY2018 to FY2020 read n/m across the change of basis; total assets' 0.24% gap moves no growth past 1%. Net margin is calculated: its revenue input carries the evidence (item 5), and it is no figure of the line's (D8: reported figures only).

cases.name: evidence_with_no_change_of_basis
cases.about: Total assets alone: a figure with evidence and no comparison that reads n/m across it.

cases.name: a_sign_change_n_m_is_no_change_of_basis
cases.about: Total assets FY2018 carries evidence with no n/m across it, beside net income's n/m from a change of sign, which carries no growth as first reported: no comparison is a later filing's, so the line names none (its n/m sentence is absent).

cases.name: a_margin_whose_input_carries_a_scale_finding
cases.about: Revenue FY2019 carries a factor of 1,000 (a note and a figure of the line); net margin, calculated, carries it on its FY2019 revenue input, so it is no figure of the line, and both series' growths as first reported are n/m on FY2019 and FY2020.

cases.name: a_null_growth_as_first_reported_counts
cases.about: Net income FY2019's yoy_first_reported is null (the n/m fired; its year before's own value is 0, so the own reports give no growth): the key's presence counts it, null and all.

cases.name: an_explicit_null_first_reported_is_no_evidence
cases.about: Revenue FY2018 carries an explicit first_reported null, which is no evidence and is not counted; total assets FY2018's is.

cases.name: a_sign_flip_and_a_scale_factor_count_as_figures
cases.about: The exact sign flip and the exact factor of 1,000 carry `disagreement` and a source_conflict note (D2 option A); each is a figure of the line (D8).

cases.name: the_window_alone_counts
cases.about: A point before the dataset's first period, with evidence and an n/m, is not counted; the periods are the window.

cases.name: no_evidence
cases.about: Net income alone: no figure carries evidence, so there is no line.
